system: Peter the Great Bay regional VTS, Sector 5 (ports of Posyet and Zarubino)
title: Vladivostok Traffic: Sector 5, Posyet Bay and Troitsa Bay (Posyet, Zarubino)
authority: Regional VTS of Peter the Great Bay acting as the port VTS, call sign "Владивосток-Трафик"; harbour masters of Posyet (Посьет-Порт-контроль) and Zarubino (Троица-33)
applies_to: All ships in the ports of Posyet (Posyet Bay section) and Zarubino (Troitsa Bay) and in Sector 5, whatever their flag.
applies_quote: Настоящие Обязательные постановления подлежат исполнению судами независимо от их национальной и ведомственной принадлежности ...

when.text: Arrival and departure information to the harbour master through www.portcall.marinet.ru (Zarubino p. 21; Posyet p. 18). Times per the General Rules: 120 to 72 hours before arrival, confirm 48 to 24 hours before; arrival application within 4 hours of first anchoring or mooring; departure application 4 hours before departure (ru-general-prearrival). From a foreign port the entry permission must also be agreed with the FSB (ru-entry-fsb-permission).

Give the General Rules p. 29 data to the VTS on entering. Zarubino: VTS on CH 16 and 71, call sign Владивосток-Трафик (p. 74); ships under way watch CH 16 and 71, at anchor and at berths CH 11 and 16 (p. 72); pilots on CH 11 and 16, call sign Гильза-2 (p. 76). Posyet: VTS on CH 71 (p. 43); ships at the berths in Posyet Bay without telephone watch CH 12 (p. 79). Traffic and anchoring only per the schedule and with VTS permission.

Zarubino: arrival and departure clearance around the clock on board or without boarding at the berths, "Рейд N 1", anchorage No. 18 and the Zarubino-1 and Zarubino-2 areas (p. 27). Navigation and weather information from the harbour master through the VTS on CH 71; daily forecast at 14.30 local time (pp. 95, 96). Dangerous goods information goes in the arrival and departure applications (p. 88).

how.note: Working channel (Zarubino Appendix 4: calling 16, 71, working 67, 71; Posyet Appendix 4: calling 16, working 71)

how.to: Посьет-Порт-контроль (state port control, Posyet Bay section)
Harbour masters of Zarubino and Posyet

lines.text: Maximum present draught and air draught
Kind of cargo, dangerous cargo on board
Defects of ship equipment and other limits that affect safe navigation

format_note: Report items from General Rules p. 29.

area.zone: Posyet Bay and Troitsa Bay, north of the line Cape Suslova to Cape Gamova

area_quote: Сектор N 5 РСУДС включает в себя бухту Троицы и залив Посьета и ограничен с юга линией, соединяющей мысы Гамова и Суслова. В секторе N 5 РСУДС действует как СУДС морского порта. (Zarubino p. 46; Posyet p. 42: "Сектор N 5 включает в себя залив Посьета и ограничен с юго-востока линией, соединяющей мыс Суслова и мыс Гамова.")
